# Legacy Flutter fixture

`flutter_schema4.sqlite` contains entirely synthetic data generated by the legacy
Flutter `CatalogDatabase(NativeDatabase(...))` and its real catalog, settings,
favorites, category ordering, EPG and history repositories. All 14 tables have
rows. It is independent of the Rust schema implementation.

The generator is retained in `generate_legacy_fixture.dart`. To reproduce it,
copy it into a separate checkout of the archived Flutter desktop source at
[commit 2829911a167bdc8e185c3b62938c1f94b53f295e](https://github.com/Fouadktb/vela/tree/2829911a167bdc8e185c3b62938c1f94b53f295e)
and run there. The current application checkout is Rust-only and intentionally
has no Flutter project:

```
flutter pub get
flutter test rust/crates/vela-core/tests/fixtures/generate_legacy_fixture.dart
```

The timestamp fields created by repository APIs will differ between runs. All
URLs use reserved `.invalid` domains; credentials are dummy fixture strings.
No installed user database was read or copied.

## Import compatibility fixtures

`legacy-playlist.expected.json` was generated by executing the actual legacy Dart
`M3uParser` against the playlist fixture. `legacy-xtream-series.expected.json`
was generated using the actual Dart `XtreamSeriesInfo.fromJson`,
`xtreamSeriesEpisodeDetails`, and `XtreamClient.buildSeriesStreamUrl` APIs.
The Rust importer compatibility tests compare against those outputs to preserve
legacy category, item, series, season, episode and stream identities. These
fixtures also contain synthetic public test data only.
